<div class="card-body">
'''Yerka Mig''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤーカ・ミッグ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の場所に配備できる。ミッグを移動させる時はキャラクターとして扱う。相手のキャラクターを一人、対象として選ぶ。選ばれたキャラクターはミッグのいる位置カードに到達すると、ミッグを捕まえる（キャンセルする）。それまでは、ミッグのいる、または隣接する位置カードでの戦闘は全て、相手の合計戦力に－１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-69o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">高度の軍事機密に通じた帝国官僚だったが、故郷の惑星ラルティアが占領され、良心の呵責から辞職し、逃亡した。現在はＩＳＢに追われる身。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Yerka Mig.

'''Card text:''' May deploy anywhere. Treat Mig as a character for movement. Target one opposing character. If that character reaches Mig's location, they catch and cancel him. Until then, subtract 1 from your opponent's total power in all battles at Mig's location or an adjacent location.

'''Lore:''' An Imperial official with access to highly classified military information. After his homeworld Ralltiir was occupied, his conscience led him to resign and flee. The ISB is now pursuing him.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Yerka Mig]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
